svg.title: One more token, different storage increments
svg.desc: MHA, GQA and MLA appear in columns, each progressing vertically from T=4 to T=5. MHA has four KV heads with two K and two V components, growing from 64 to 80; GQA has two KV heads, growing from 32 to 40; MLA stores three latent and two shared positional-key components, growing from 20 to 25. Equal-size cells represent components; only the new p4 row has an orange outline. Increments are 16,8,5. Mobile stacks the three comparisons.
